title: Strict reduction and normalized realization of completed open extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $\widehat R_T=\lim_n(A_n)_T$, $T=U,X$, and identify $j^{-1}\widehat R_X=\widehat R_U$. Use the strict semilinear system category, reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$, and unit $u$ and counit $e$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $J_j$ be exact termwise system extension by zero, and let $j_!$ be localized ringed-site extension by zero for the completed coefficient sheaves [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization].

For any derived-complete $K\in D(\widehat R_U)$, with completeness meaning the quotient-tower condition of [def-weil-derived-complete], extension by zero on a flat-term K-flat reduction representative induces a specified natural isomorphism of derived semilinear systems
$$r_j(K):\mathcal R_X(j_!K)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_UK.$$
Its evaluation at $n$ is the canonical open-tensor coefficient isomorphism $(j_!K)\otimes^L_{\widehat R_X}(A_n)_X\cong j_!(K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_U}(A_n)_U)$, and it respects every strict quotient transition. The object $j_!K$ is derived complete. If $u_{j_!K}$ denotes the actual reduction/total-limit unit, then it is invertible and
$$d_j(K)=u_{j_!K}^{-1}\circ\mathcal L_X(r_j(K))^{-1}:\mathcal L_XJ_j\mathcal R_UK\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!K.$$
With the corresponding completed restriction pullback, this comparison identifies the realized open adjunction unit and counit with the localized ringed-site unit and counit. These are comparisons of the specified simultaneous section constructions of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], not choices of lifts of their evaluations.
